CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION order_prune_history(retention_days INTEGER DEFAULT 30, max_rows INTEGER DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS BIGINT AS $$
DECLARE
  deleted_count BIGINT;
BEGIN
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT h.history_id
    FROM order_history h
    WHERE h.recorded_at < now() - make_interval(days => retention_days)
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM order_history newer
        WHERE newer.id = h.id
          AND newer._version > h._version
      )
    LIMIT max_rows
  ),
  deleted AS (
    DELETE FROM order_history h
    USING candidates c
    WHERE h.history_id = c.history_id
    RETURNING 1
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO deleted_count FROM deleted;
  RETURN deleted_count;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
